styles.characters: 3D Stylized (e.g., Pixar or Fortnite style), vibrant colors, smooth textures, soft lighting, solid color background.
styles.landmarks: 3D Stylized icon, simplified geometry, isometric view, toy-like appearance, vibrant colors, solid color background.
styles.ui: Flat, vibrant, modern, clean, solid color background.

characters.template: A 3D stylized avatar of a {description}, asymmetric design, highly distinct personality, {style_characters}
examples: rebellious teenage skateboarder with mismatched shoes, a crooked backwards cap, and a scraped knee
intense competitive basketball player with a sweatband over one eye and a colorful neon arm sleeve
quirky casual player wearing vintage neon roller skates, oversized asymmetrical sunglasses, and a fanny pack
generic soccer field with bright green turf, corner flags, and a scattered ball
generic sand volleyball court with a sun-bleached net and sandy dunes
generic petanque court with gravel texture, wooden borders, and scattered metal boules
generic outdoor bowling alley with shiny wooden lanes, retro pins, and neon accents

ui_buttons.template: A modern flat UI action button for '{button_text}', vibrant, clean, {style_ui}

ui_panels.template: A modern flat UI panel for '{panel_type}', vibrant, clean, {style_ui}

asset_generation_workflow.step_1: Generate raw images using OpenArt based on the specified templates and examples.
asset_generation_workflow.step_2: Run the local post-processing script (`process_assets.js` or `.py`) to crop images and remove backgrounds where necessary.
asset_generation_workflow.step_3: The script will automatically convert all final assets to highly-optimized `.webp` format.
asset_generation_workflow.step_4: Save the optimized WebP images directly to the `public/assets/` directory.
